slots.title: Historical road network around Sarkhej Roza
slots.evidenceRequired: A dated road centreline layer for a year before the S.G. Highway widening (for example vectorised from a Survey of India topographic sheet or a dated development plan), georeferenced with at least 4 control points and RMSE of 25 m or less, with the sheet number, survey year and rights statement.
acceptableSources: Survey of India topographic sheets (rights must permit reuse)
AUDA development plan base maps
A dated OpenStreetMap extract whose timestamp can be verified

slots.title: S.G. Highway and Sarkhej circle works as built

layers.title: Open water within 500 m of Sarkhej Roza, 1990-11-11 (Landsat)

meta.title: Open water within 500 m of Sarkhej Roza, 1990-11-11 (Landsat)

source.title: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 scene LT05_L2SP_149044_19901111_02_T1 (public domain), via Microsoft Planetary Computer

meta.method: Pixels with MNDWI (green, SWIR-1) above 0.0 whose centre lies within 500 m of the Roza, vectorised along pixel edges (30 m) and reprojected from EPSG:32642 to WGS 84 by ml/past_water_green.py. Scene acquired 1990-11-11.
meta.limitations: Post-monsoon water on one day, so the outline depends on that year's rainfall. Edges follow 30 m pixels, so a stepped outline, not a surveyed shoreline. Includes the Sarkhej tank and any other water in the circle; it is not the tank's design outline and says nothing about encroachment.

measurements.title: Built-up surface in the Sarkhej-Makarba study window (GHSL, modelled)
measurements.method: Sum of GHS-BUILT-S R2023A built-up surface (square metres per 3 arc-second cell, converted to hectares) inside the fixed window west 72.44, south 22.93, east 72.58, north 23.05 (WGS 84), same window and product in every epoch. Computed by ml/past_builtup.py on 2026-11-22.
measurements.limits: A modelled estimate from satellite imagery, not a survey. Cells are about 90 m, so small buildings and narrow roads are not resolved. Earlier epochs rest on sparser imagery and are less certain. The window is a rectangle, not an administrative boundary, and covers more than Makarba.

source.title: JRC Global Human Settlement Layer, GHS-BUILT-S R2023A (CC BY 4.0)

measurements.title: Open water within 500 m of Sarkhej Roza, post-monsoon (Landsat, modelled)
measurements.method: Pixels with MNDWI (green, SWIR-1) above 0.0 whose centre lies within 500 m of the Roza (22.99342 N, 72.50539 E), times 900 m2. One Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 scene per year: WRS-2 path 149 row 044, Tier 1, Landsat 5 TM or 8/9 OLI, acquired 11-01 to 12-15 (month-day), the clearest with under 1% fill, cloud or shadow in the window by its QA band (falling back to the neighbouring year when none is clear). Scenes: 1990-11-11 LT05_L2SP_149044_19901111_02_T1; 1995-11-09 LT05_L2SP_149044_19951109_02_T1; 2000-11-22 LT05_L2SP_149044_20001122_02_T1; 2015-11-16 LC08_L2SP_149044_20151116_02_T1; 2024-11-08 LC08_L2SP_149044_20241108_02_T1. Computed by ml/past_water_green.py on 2026-11-23.
measurements.limits: The 500 m circle contains the Sarkhej tank but is not a tank outline; other water in the circle (a second pond to the north-west on these images) is counted too. Moving the MNDWI threshold from -0.1 to 0.1 changes each value by about 20% without changing their order. This is not an encroachment measurement and cannot date the loss of the tank's area. One date per year, so values reflect that year's monsoon and the acquisition day as much as lasting change. 30 m pixels; thresholds are conventional and not calibrated against ground observations; Landsat 5 TM and Landsat 8/9 OLI differ slightly in band response.

source.title: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance (public domain), via Microsoft Planetary Computer
